title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Priority of Acquisition)
(1) Where the aggregate amount of private investments for which applications have been submitted under Article 2 exceeds the amount appropriated in the budget under Article 3 (1), the Government shall acquire such investments in the order in which applications were submitted, within the limits of the budget.
(2) Private investments that could not be acquired under paragraph (1) shall be acquired preferentially in the following fiscal year.
